body.message:
Thank you, but this is an urgent health and safety issue, especially because my children are being affected.

I cannot continue staying in this apartment while there is a bed bug infestation. My son has had a severe reaction around his eye and has been unable to sleep because of the itching and discomfort.

I need an immediate solution. I am requesting either:

1. An immediate transfer to a clean, safe apartment with no bed bugs, or
2. A refund for one full day so I can book a hotel and move my children to a safe place.

Please understand that I cannot wait for a lengthy investigation while my children are suffering. I have photos and evidence of the bed bugs and the condition of the apartment.

Please confirm as soon as possible which solution you can provide.
